name: Wishcore
summary: The aesthetic emphasizes "soft and fluffy" textures alongside themes of magic and quiet self-expression.
description: The aesthetic emphasizes "soft and fluffy" textures alongside themes of magic and quiet self-expression. It serves as a style for internalized emotions, specifically the desire for protection or hope for the future (守られたい, meaning "I want to be protected"), prioritizing subtle communication over bold assertion.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Wish, magical realism, comfort, innocence, subtle self-expression, desire for protection (守られたい)

visualDNA.colour: Pastel pink, light blue, white, cream, subtle holographic/iridescent accents

fashion.Overview: Wishcore manifests through personalized accessories and decorative fan culture rather than conspicuous clothing. The style prioritizes small, customized objects such as phone cases, toploaders for photocards, nail art, and keychains adorned with stickers and star charms. This focus on "K-pop Deco" allows for subtle expression suitable for daily life. When applied to apparel, the aesthetic favors simple items like fluffy accessories, angel wing hair clips, or garments with border prints, often drawing influence from Harajuku Fashion and Balletcore.
